How do they put the holes in Swiss cheese? How do they restore and improve a classic battle tank? And how do robotic librarians run one of the world's biggest book collections.
How do they persuade an oyster to grow a perfect pearl? How do they put the twist in classic Pennsylvania pretzels? And how do they build Venice's traditional gondolas.
Serkan and Jay visit a Victorian steam museum, while Serkan and Alister Dryburgh get to trawl through storage containers at a Kent country house.
Serkan, Jay and Viki hunt for items with remarkable history. In Somerset they visit a family-run quarry, and a collection of circus artefacts.
Paul and Drew take on their biggest restoration yet, a VW Beetle Karmann Cabriolet. The car is in terrible condition, but Drew is determined to save it.
More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including levels, hot dogs, abrasive grains and sandpaper.
More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including ice cream treats, wooden golf clubs and aircraft wings.
Teleshopping.
Teleshopping.
Automata artisans Michael and Maria restore an acrobatic figurine from France. Meanwhile, sculptor Nick revives a pair of fairground ride motorbikes.
Drew heads to a Kent antiques emporium specialising in unusual European antiques, and indulges in 1940s nostalgia at a home front museum in South West Wales.
Drew goes North of the border on a road trip for an epic private house clearance in a remote part of Scotland, and he visits a historic cutlery factory in Sheffield.
The Poseidon Crew receive devastating news about their mining permits. The Dust Devils gamble big on a quartz reef. Shane and Russell strike gold.
A new crew are under threat from crocodiles and accusations of illegal prospecting. The Victoria Diggers receive some welcome help.
The Boulder Boys drain floodwater in search of opals. Rod Manning is under pressure after using his wife's favourite opal ring as collateral.
The Blacklighters must relocate Opalzilla after their claim runs dry of opal. The Cheals hope to hit the jackpot in a bizarre structure, the Z-fault.
Drew and Tee are excited by the items on offer at the largest antiques market in Italy. And, they visit a picturesque town in Spain to look at a fascinating collection.
Henry and Fuzz visit Warwickshire to revive a battered Ford Transit. Once a workhorse of Britain, now a rusted relic longing for a second life.
Henry and Fuzz head to Southend to visit Graham's shed full of bikes and muscle cars. They find a Dutton kit car and rows and rows of rare bikes.
Henry and Fuzz visit a farm near Colchester with vintage tractors galore. The boys come away with a classic Fordson and some old traffic lights.

pr.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
pr.d: Henry and Simon head to High Wycombe, Buckinghamshire to unearth some treasures in the barns. They spot a pair of ornate candle holders and a go-cart.
In Dom Littlewood's stylish seaside pad, Angus finds a rare guitar. Then, he checks out 1950s treasures at soap star Lisa George's home.
A Lost Masterpiece? Angus spies a treasure whilst helping a couple downsize and turns detective to identify whether a work of art is by a very famous artist or not.
In the border towns of Scotland and England, who is the mysterious lady in the photograph, and will a parrot make the journey home.
In Chelmsford, Henry and Fuzz visit Fiat specialist Tristan, who has 500s, 600s, 126s and a Fiat minivan that once starred in an Indiana Jones movie.
The boys are in Oxfordshire browsing through Dominic's restoration projects, including a Triumph TR4, a Jaguar XJS and a hotrod with a Rover engine.
Opalton Boulder Crew are going to the Winton Opal Festival, Slim Pickings are finally at White Peg, and the Mooka Boys have driven to Coober Pedy.
Furniture restorer Will attempts to help Katherine and John who have an heirloom that's been deemed unusable. Can Will bring this beautiful piece back to life.
Japanese scientists stimulate oysters to form perfect pearls. Handcrafted pretzels are made with a twist. Workers maintain the craft of the gondolier.
Roulette wheels are made to be perfectly unpredictable. The secrets behind the purest olive oil are revealed. An old wreck is made into the Batmobile.

pr.t: How (Not) To Get Rid Of A Body
pr.d: After a young Ohio man vanishes without a trace, detectives embark on an investigation involving a love triangle, drugs, and murder.

pr.t: How (Not) To Get Rid Of A Body
pr.d: Charred and decomposed human remains are found in the Poconos. It takes Pennsylvania State Troopers more than a decade to solve the case.

When the engines have the day off, Percy reluctantly agrees to referee their obstacle course race. But with each race, the teams get upset with Percy's rulings.
Grandad clears some caterpillars off his veg and safely puts them in a box for rehoming, but when Stan checks, all he finds is a strange object..
Stan keeps hearing the tune of an ice cream van but it's not there! Seals are singing, whistles are blowing and birds are barking! What's going on.
When Tia misses the Spinny Star, Tim tries to recreate it for her.
Tim and Kai try to uncover trinkets buried at the beach.
Tim, Tommy, Tia and Dad get stuck on a remote asteroid.
The Windsor Ruby is missing in 'Paddington's Adventure Club Cracks The Case!', then in 'Paddington And Aunt Lucy's Special Recipe', the Browns set up a takeaway, but it's hard work.
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is a hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby.
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Granny Sheep is driving Vanessa, the art van along the road with Peppa, Suzy, Pedro, Mandy, Molly and Danny. They are taking her to the boat yard, for her first-ever outing.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School, and learn about what to expect when the baby arrives.
Peppa is so excited to meet her new baby brother or sister, but they are taking forever to arrive until suddenly Mummy Pig announces the baby is coming, now.
Peppa is given the very important task of suggesting names for the new baby. She thinks of all sorts of names, but they aren't quite right.
The nurse visits, and she decides that today's visit should be all about how to hold a baby. The nurse shows Peppa a special way for a small person to safely hold a baby.
Dr Brown Bear suggests Peppa and George have their hearing checked. The audiologist discovers George has a moderate hearing loss and suggests George tries a hearing aid.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his new hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of a muddy puddle.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay.
Grandpa Pig found his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to leave! Peppa and Suzy look after him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable.
A magical card arrives in the Little Kingdom, inviting everyone to a party at Granny and Granpapa Thistle's castle in the clouds.
Ben and Holly are having fun playing in the meadow. Holly gets frustrated when Ben uses his elf skills to win all the games. Ben gets frustrated when Holly uses her magic skills.
Today, Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Larenzo Lion who lives there! Larenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms.
At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and how to take the right stance.
Bull Digs Up The River: Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They see Mr. Bull, who's using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
When Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit that she wants to exercise more, he builds something special to help her.
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig, complete with costumes and a Jolly Roger flag.
During a picnic in her garden, cousin Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with wild flowers.
Auntie, Uncle Pig and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late - she even stayed up later than the Daddies.
Daddy Pig's marathon training continues. There isn't long to go before the big day! Peppa takes the role as Daddy's coach and, with George, devises lots of fun games to help.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby.
Peppa is so excited to meet her new baby brother or sister, but they are taking forever to arrive until suddenly Mummy Pig announces the baby is coming, now.
Bull The Teacher: Madame Gazelle leaves the class with Mr Bull while she goes to the dentist. But the children already know the subjects Mr Bull suggests teaching.
Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.
Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play Flying Discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents.
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.
Peppa and her family take a poorly swift to the vet's. After a night of rest, the swift recovers and Doctor Hamster releases it so it can fly around the world again.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the Skate Park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard.
Mr Labrador is here in his new ice cream van. It is his first day selling ice creams. In fact, Mr Labrador loves ice cream - perhaps a little too much.
Granny and Grandpa Pig decide to go and pick their own strawberries at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm.
First, Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars play centre, where Miss Rabbit is in charge.
The new club house has a little counter, ideal for playing shop. But what will the children's new club house shop sell.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They then hide away in it during the snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and Peppa's igloo too.
The children learn about the weather. There is a new friend for Peppa, and Grandpa Pig is making a rock garden.
Today is Mandy Mouse's birthday, and as a special treat, Mandy is going to Cheese World with her friends. It is the most fun ever.
Peppa and George dress up as Romans, make a pebble mosaic and even learn a little Latin.
Peppa and her family have gone on holiday, staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach. They discover that even when it rains, they can have lots of fun.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleepover - different friends in each of the apartments in the high street. So they play hide and seek across all the rooms.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay.

While Mummy Pig is hard at work, Peppa, George and Daddy make the best out of not being able to use the computer by tidying the kitchen.
Peppa and George are in for a treat when they embark on a camping trip to the seaside with Granny and Grandpa.
Peppa and Suzy Sheep are spending a day helping Dr Hamster the Vet. They meet so many pets and have such fun.
Peppa and her friends are at playgroup with Madame Gazelle, and the children will be learning about the weather by building a weather station.
Peppa goes to the opticians for an eye test and tries out spectacles of all different shapes and colours.
When Tiddles the Tortoise gets stuck in a tree, Pedro Pony has trouble trying to rescue him.
Daddy Pig reads Peppa and George a bedtime story to help them fall asleep. When George wakes up again Peppa has to make up a bedtime story to get him back to sleep.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa and her friend Suzy Sheep old photographs from when they were babies.
It is bedtime, and to help Peppa and George go to sleep, Daddy Pig tells them the story of "The Sleepy Princess".
Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George sailing, but they keep getting stuck in the mud.
When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Three clocks are much better than one. Mr Fox has everything in his van - even a chicken.
Peppa and George have fun playing detectives.
It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited, and that can only mean one thing; Soft Play.
Peppa and George meet Kylie Kangaroo and her brother Joey. Peppa shows Kylie how to jump up and down in muddy puddles, but who can jump the highest.
The playgroup is going on a trip to the museum.
Peppa loves the school fete. Her favourite things are face painting, the balloons and the bouncy castle.
Peppa, George and Daddy Pig prepare a wonderful birthday surprise for Mummy Pig.
It is Talent Day at Peppa's playgroup, and Madame Gazelle wants everyone to show the class their special talent.
Oh, no! George has lost Mr. Dinosaur! Maybe the police can help George find him.
Mummy Pig suggests they all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then actually bump into Mrs Crocodile. Then Mr Lion invites them to a picnic.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language. Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his new hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of a muddy puddle.
Peppa and her friends are introduced to some simple woodcraft in the woods with Mr Wolf.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea, and gives them tips on how to stay safe.
Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero-themed party and Super Potato is one of the guests.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own endings too.
Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night. But before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, and which popcorn to eat.
The children make good use of their clubhouse by playing an adventure game, imaginging that there are wild animals outside - even if it is just Daddy Pig.
Peppa and her friends go to school early to have breakfast together.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit takes the children for swimming lessons in the little children's pool. At the end of the lesson, giant inflatables are brought out including an inflatable slide.
Today is the grown-ups' singing competition at the theatre and the kids are the judges. The children jump up and down and sing along. Everybody loves singing.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first.
Mr Bull arrives with his team to start work on Peppa's house renovation. Peppa and family move into the caravan in the garden while the work is being completed.
Madame Gazelle gets the playgroup to play music - with instruments that they must make themselves.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful minigolf course next door.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies.
Dr Hamster is visiting the playgroup today and has brought a giant ant farm. But nobody notices when they escape and start moving things in the classroom.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in! She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio.
Grampy Rabbit's new jet pack shoots off into the distance and he ends up on top of a snowy mountain.
Peppa's family car breaks down. While it is being mended, they borrow a shiny new one from Grandad Dog's garage.
Peppa and her family visit Windy Castle. The view from Windy Castle is fantastic - Peppa and George can even see Granny and Grandpa's house.
Peppa's family go to the museum's Moon Exhibition with George's friend Edmond Elephant.
Miss Rabbit hurts her ankle, so Mummy Rabbit takes over her job at the supermarket. Miss Rabbit has lots of other jobs, so Daddy Pig and Granddad Dog help out too.
Pedro Pony spends the day just like a real cowboy would have in the Wild West: setting up camp in the garden and sharing stories with his friends.
Wendy Wolf's birthday is here and she has invited Peppa and friends around for a party.
Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig's boat for a day on the river. Daddy Pig is the captain, Peppa, George and Mummy Pig are the crew. But then the boat gets stuck.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre and needs fixing, Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket. George sits in the trolley, while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list. Daddy Pig picks up something not on the list.
It's Peppa Pig's birthday today. She wakes up very early so that none of her special day is wasted. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks, and makes a birthday cake appear.
Peppa and George are going to Granny and Grandpa's for Sunday lunch, but get stuck in a traffic jam.
When Peppa meets Father Christmas at the supermarket, she invites him to her playgroup's Christmas play.
The Biggest Muddy Puddle In The World: Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island.
Peppa and George have one more game of jumping up and down in muddy puddles before bedtime.
Peppa and George visit Rebecca Rabbit's house today. Rebecca's house is a bit different to Peppa's house - it is inside a hill! And instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels.
Peppa and her friends play with their toy boats at the pond.
Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to see a fish pond he used to visit when he was a little piggy.
The family car is very muddy. Peppa and George have lots of fun helping Mummy and Daddy clean it.
Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children quickly catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill.
Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it's Freddy Fox with his super smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

Peppa loses Teddy at a picnic, and Zoe Zebra has to rescue him.
Peppa and George meet their new cousin, a tiny baby piggy called Alexander.

Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.
Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her chickens, whilst something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse. Grampy Rabbit knows all about the sea, and can make a lot of noise too, which is useful.
It is raining outside so Peppa and George have to stay indoors. While they wait for the rain to stop, Daddy Pig teaches them a fun game.
It's all play and not much work when Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office.
Peppa and her friends are going camping. Madame Gazelle, their teacher, is in charge. First they put up their tents. Then they collect sticks to make a campfire.
Gerald Giraffe is new to playgroup! He's trying to make friends with Peppa and the group, but finds being so tall is making playing hide and seek quite a challenge.
Mummy and Daddy Pig, Peppa and George have a wonderful day with Mr. Potato at Digger World.
George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa doesn't like spiders and screams very loudly. But soon she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her.
Peppa's French friend Delphine Donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song'.

Peppa and George learn there's lots of fun to be had at the beach, even when there's no sand.

Grampy Rabbit visits Peppa's playgroup to talk about space rockets.
Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson. Peppa loves dancing. Everyone loves dancing.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: A Puppy Party reunites Boss Baby with his foe Bug the Pug.
Paper and Pencil tell a kind of funny joke in 'Paper and Pencil Tell a Joke', then in 'Scissors' Orchestra', Scissors gets a famous girlfriend.
Lil & Jack get stranded on an island in 'The Secret of Lake Island', then in 'Father, Son, And Furniture Store', Jack & Will explore a shop of oddities.
Lily sleuths Jack's secret morning life in 'Before 10AM', and in 'LAD', Lil & BFFs are chased by their enemy.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Boss Baby promises to help Tim with their parents' anniversary gift but sends Hendershot instead after Puppy Co. and Baby Corp clash. Hendershot tries to keep Tim happy.
Jeanette is proclaimed a fashion trendsetter by Brittany's icon in 'She's Got Style', then in 'Super Heroes', Theodore thinks he's a real superhero, and Alvin and Simon can't convince him.
When Phoebe learns Max's band plans to dump him, she suspects that his superhero training is hurting his friendships. Determined to help, her good deeds backfire.
Preoccupied with Z-Force training, Phoebe & Max learn that they've forgotten special family events. Wanting to make it up, Phoebe plans a family fun day.
When a video of Henry and Ray transforming into Kid Danger and Captain Man gets out, Henry must get it back so that his secret identity isn't revealed.
Henry and Charlotte are transported into an opposite universe where Ray and Schwoz are evil and want to destroy Piper. They must figure out how to get back.
Jade faces Mr Best in a dance off in 'Dance Off', then in 'The Show Must Go On', the Marsups save the twins play.
Gargamel clones himself to capture all one hundred Smurfs. But three Gargamels are not the best idea! (S3, ep 7a).
Gargamel is looking for a talisman that will help him to find the Smurfies' village. Storm decides that she's going to get there before him. But it's a trap.
The Smurfs unwittingly ask Dimwitty for advice when he gets stuck in a hollowed out tree, thinking they've found the Tree of Knowledge. (S3, ep 7b).
We find out who can scare Storm in 'Scary Stories', then in 'The Smurf Who Lost His Shadow', Hefty's shadow wants to be free, but once they're separated, they're both in danger.
Alvin's convinced Dave will abandon him in the desert in 'Deserted', and in 'The Great Snack Off', Alvin and Theodore play a seemingly innocent game, which leads to unexpected consequences.
Alvin almost drives a local toy store out of business in 'Unboxing Day', then in 'Dave's Pavillion', Dave's new pavilion is surprisingly ruined for some reason. But who is to blame.

An old friend Shoot comes back to town in 'Shoot', then in 'Rock's First Day of Work', Rock starts his job as Franz Roll's assistant and learns just how demanding his role model truly is.
Krabs wants to give his daughter the best birthday ever in 'Whale of a Birthday', then in 'Karate Island', SpongeBob gets an invitation to take part in a competition to be crowned King of Karate.
SpongeBob is in danger from a mad strangler in 'SpongeBob Meets The Strangler', and then in 'Pranks A Lot', SpongeBob and Patrick have fun with some invisibility spray, and prank the whole town.
In 'Nature Pants' SpongeBob decides to try and live life with the jellyfish, and in 'Opposite Day' Squidward tries to sell his house despite his annoying neighbours.
Squidward is not allowed into SpongeBob and Patrick's treehouse in 'Club SpongeBob', and then in 'My Pretty Seahorse', SpongeBob adopts a sea horse, and takes it everywhere.
Mr Krabs makes his number one employee take his first ever day off, in 'Bummer Vacation', and then in 'Wig Struck', SpongeBob finds an old wig, and wears it all around town, thinking that it's cool.
Plankton replaces the Chum Bucket with a Roman coliseum (and togas!) in 'Spongicus', and then in 'Suctioncup Symphony', Squidward is sure to win a music contest - if SpongeBob and Patrick stay quiet.
Squidward cleans up the city of Bikini Bottom with help from SpongeBob in 'Keep Bikini Bottom Beautiful', and then in 'A Pal for Gary', SpongeBob brings Gary a pet that terrorizes him.
Sandy gets a brand-new suit in 'The Suit Suits You', then in 'Parasite Pals', SpongeBob's newest friend is a hungry parasite inside of him.
Patrick's injury recovery causes trouble for the camp in 'Five Times The Fun', then in 'Low Falutin', Rea and Roh learn to support themselves.
All is quiet while SpongeBob is 'House Sitting for Sandy' - until Patrick shows up! And in 'Smooth Jazz at Bikini Bottom', SpongeBob and Squidward try to sneak backstage at the Kelpy G concert.
Sandy tries to study SpongeBob and Patrick's behaviour in 'The Fishbowl', and then in 'Married to Money', Mr Krabs takes Plankton's advice and finally marries the only thing he ever loved... money.
SpongeBob doesn't need a licence to operate a self-driving car in 'Drive Happy', then in 'Old Man Patrick', Patrick thinks he's an old man, so SpongeBob reminds him how much fun being a kid can be.
Patrick and Squidward must survive together in the woods in 'Squisery', and in 'Game Night', The adults sneak away to play a board game, but they have to hide from one camper in particular.
The campers meet two backwoods narwhals in 'Sugar Squeeze', then in 'Tag, You're It', On a rainy day, SpongeBob and his friends entertain themselves indoors with a turbulent game of tag.
SpongeBob and Squidward try to sell krabby patties from a truck in the depths of the ocean in 'Food PBBFT! Truck', then in 'Upturn Girls', Pearl and Narlene have a whales' day out in the big city.
The Star Family is a team of superheroes in 'Super Stars', and then in 'Now Museum, Now You Don't', Cecil works security at Lady Upturn's art museum.
The Patricks compete for control of the TV remote in 'Pat-Tathlon', then in 'Upturn's Downturn', after driving over Patrick, a court order forces Lady Upturn to live with the Star family.
An accident causes Patrick and Karen to switch bodies in 'Switch Glitch', then in 'Prickly Pests', a mischievous camp prank goes terribly wrong.
It's stand-up comedy night at Kamp Koral, and the campers are ready to laugh until they scream in 'Wise Kraken', then in 'Squatch Swap', Patrick gets confused while out in the woods.
SpongeBob, Sandy, and Patrick hike through the woods in search of a fabled nudist colony in 'In Search of Camp Noodist', then in 'Kitchen Sponge', SpongeBob helps at the Krusty Kanteen.
SpongeBob misplaces his lucky tie clip in 'Bad Luck Bob', then in 'The Sandman Cometh', Patrick suddenly can't fall asleep.
Patrick learns what GrandPat's childhood was like in 'Little Patscals', and then in 'The Pre-Historic Patrick Star Show', Cave Pat hosts a show with his cave family.
After getting rid of Ouchie, Pinkeye takes over the Star house in 'Get Ouch', and in 'Day of the Living Dad Jokes', Patrick and Squidina must find safety amidst the dad joke apocalypse.
SpongeBob can't understand why no-one wants to go near him in "Something Smells.
Patrick and Squidina report the news in 'Nitwit Neighbourhood News', then in 'Mid-Season Finale', The Patrick Show presents the epic conclusion to the first half of its first season.
Bunny must punish Patrick for chocolate-flavoured crimes in 'At Home, On the Lam', then in 'Pick Patrick's Path', the Lawnies vote for what Patrick does next.
Mr Krabs retires and sells the restaurant in 'Selling Out', and then in 'Funny Pants', Squidward has finally had just about enough of SpongeBob's annoying laughter.
Krabs reignites his passion for clowning in 'Krabsy the Klown', then in 'Lords of the LARP', Mo learns a new kind of fun and camaraderie.
Plankton discovers competition in Narlene's backwoods restaurant in 'Taste of Defeat', then in 'Scaredy Squirrel', Sandy spends a night at the Trawler cabin.
It's a battle of the restaurants in '20,000 Patties Under The Sea', and then in 'The Battle Of Bikini Bottom', Patrick and SpongeBob discover that they have very different views about cleanliness.
Squidward gets stuck indoors with SpongeBob and Patrick during a storm in 'Pineapple Fever', and then in 'Chum Caverns', Plankton creates an underground restaurant that rivals the Krusty Krab.
Patrick is mistaken for a corporate retreat leader in 'Retreat!', then in 'Sidekick Search', Patrick and Squidina hold auditions for a Patrick Show sidekick.
Bubble Bass reviews The Patrick Show in 'Bubble Bass Reviews', and then in 'Patrick's Prison Pals', Bunny brings Patrick to prison for Bring Your Kid To Work Day.
Patrick gets some luxury pampering in 'Patrick's Staycation', and then in 'Walking The Plankton', Plankton wonders who's looking after the Krabby Patty formula while Mr Krabs is on a cruise.
SpongeBob's life changes in unexpected ways in 'SpongeBob LongPants', and then in 'Larry's Gym', when Larry the Lobster opens a new gym in Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob becomes his best customer.
Camp Master Krabs finally hires a camp nurse in 'First Aid Last Aid', then in 'Night of the Living Stench', all the campers try to win the Stinkiest Camp in the Forest award.
An unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers in 'What About Meep?', then in 'Hard Time Out', SpongeBob is sent to time out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to help.
Patrick hosts a countrified variety show. in 'Sea Haw', then in 'Li'l Past-cals', The Kelpbed Kids travel to the future to get their kicking can back.
Patrick messes with the space-time continuum in 'The Patterfly Effect', then in 'A Space Affair to Remember', Cecil and Bunny celebrate their anniversary in outer space.
Squidward joins a crew of sailors hunting down the great white jellyfish. Plankton finds a magic bean that takes him to a land of giants (well, more giant than usual).
Krabs finds pets are profitable in 'A Place for Pets', then in 'Lockdown for Love', Plankton ruins another date with Karen, so she puts the Chum Bucket on lockdown until he proves his affection.
Patrick and Squidina go undercover to investigate a corrupt novelty product factory in 'Patrickle Jokes', then in 'Pat Roast', The Patrick Show presents The Roast of Patrick Star.
A classic villain returns to his former lair, only to find the Star Family inhabiting it in 'X Marks the Pot', then in 'Patrick's Alley', The Patrick Show rebrands for a younger audience.
The Stars celebrate Patrick's birthday at the Chum Bucket in 'The Fun Bucket', then in 'The Patrick Show After Dark', Patrick and Squidina explore Bikini Bottom late at night.
SpongeBob finds a cute but inconvenient companion in 'Lighthouse Louie', then in 'Hiccup Plague', no one in Bikini Bottom is safe from a case of contagious hiccups.
Krabs hires Squidward to babysit Pearl for the night in 'Whale Watching', then in 'Krusty Kleaners', after spilling a milkshake during a delivery, SpongeBob vows to clean the entire building.
SpongeBob cares for the stray snails that start appearing around Bikini Bottom in 'Sanctuary!', while in 'What's Eating Patrick?', Patrick enters a Krabby Patty eating competition.
Mr Krabs resorts to desperate measures after Plankton drives away his customers in 'Free Samples', and then in 'Home Sweet Rubble', SpongeBob's pineapple is falling apart, and needs re-modelling.
Patrick's big sister Samantha comes for a visit in 'Big Sister Sam', and then in 'Perfect Chemistry', Sandy and Plankton bond over their shared love of science.
We check on Patrick's morning routine in 'Rise and Shine', SpongeBob must be patient for his cereal-based entertainment in 'Waiting', and then in 'Fungus Among Us', SpongeBob develops a case of Ick.

Rick takes us to the place where his passion for Cornwall began - his family home at Trevose Head on the north Cornish coast, where he would go fishing with his father as a child.
Rick takes us to meet an extraordinary family who are making some of the best Gouda cheese in Britain and discovers the origins of the sea shanty in the fishing village of Mevagissey.
Rick meets young chef Tom Adams, who runs Combeshead Farm, a leading field-to-fork restaurant in Cornwall. Rick then tries out a new recipe - pork chops with a sloe berry sauce.
Rick discovers an unusual superstition and a rare type of Norman castle in Launceston, before meeting musicians Graham Fitkin and Ruth Wall in the far west of Cornwall.
The bikers continue their journey through time, celebrating British grub. Here, they look at the influence of the Mediterranean on British cuisine.
Timothy West and Prunella Scales embark on a spectacular canal journey to Venice, beginning 14 miles west of the Italian city on the Brenta.
Motoring news and views with those car-crazed chums. Jeremy tests out the Dodge Viper and Richard tries out some incredible prototypes. Joanna Lumley is their fabulous guest.
The motorbike racer and mechanic heads to Bala Lake to try to set the world record for riding a motorcycle on the surface of water.
